user.title: Connect your Tuya account
user.description: Use the same account, application and country calling code as the mobile app. The password is used for login and is not stored.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect your Tuya account
reauth_confirm.description: The current Tuya session expired. Enter the account password to issue a new session; the password is not stored.

error.mfa_required: Tuya requires an additional verification step
error.profile_expired: The bundled mobile application profile is no longer accepted
error.no_devices: No devices were found in this account

abort.wrong_account: The credentials belong to a different Tuya account
